removed_results: This map shows response relative to each construct’s reference, not measured transfection efficiency or absolute sensing strength. Each stimulus and reference comes from a separate single well. Or7a’s near-one valeric-acid ratio therefore does not identify it as the strongest responder; the corrected values in Figure 13 preserve the corrected-change magnitudes.
Stock concentrations were not supplied for Test 2. Repeated time points describe within-well trajectories and do not provide independent biological replication.
The blank also set the positivity threshold. Its 1/170 fraction is therefore a calibration diagnostic rather than an independently estimated false-positive rate.
